title: Bad Apples

videos.title: Korah wants to be in charge

textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
in today’s true Bible lesson
we see that there are bad apples in the camp.

THEY WANT TO BE IN CHARGE
-
Let us see what Moses does
and let us see what God does

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for keeping your promises.
Please help me to keep my eyes on You
and to always trust You.
Amen
